notes.title: Demo Update 0.9.9
notes.notes:
Added 7 more achievements

You can now press ESC during the opening part of the game in the main menu to skip the wait

notes.title: Demo Update 0.9.5
notes.notes: Fixed achievements not triggering the steam notification when getting one

notes.title: Demo Update 0.9.0
notes.notes:
Added MacOS and Linux Builds

Updated the UI in the Office and Camera

Updated the UI in the Character and Relic Menu

Several small issues fixed

Added localizations for some strings

Added the first achievement

notes.title: Demo Update 0.8.12
notes.notes: Fixed some bugs and improved stability including the issue of a black screen when opening the cams

notes.title: Demo Update 0.8.1
notes.notes: Added a setting for changing the amount of post processing applied to be able to increase fps on low end hardware

notes.title: Demo Update 0.8
notes.notes:
Additions
Added a render scale setting that allows you set the resolution to a lower value to increase fps

Added a small cooldown to the an interactable object in the office
Changes
Decreased size of text in the relic selection menu

Increased the speed of the cellar enemy on cam D4
Fixes
Fixed enemies not being reset properly as they should 

Fixed the camera relic visuals not being displayed properly in some cases

Fixed an issue with the German localization

notes.title: Demo Update 0.7.36
notes.notes: Fixed the game crashing on launch

notes.title: Demo Update 0.7.35
notes.notes:
Fixed custom night not working

Fixed visual indicator for when a relic cannot be used

Fixed cursor not updating when hovering over relic button

Decreased size of usage indicators

notes.title: Demo Update 0.7.(34)
notes.notes:
Added custom night which unlocks after completing the second night

Added an unlock screen which displays information on things that you unlocked

Added the German language

Added a custom cursor 

Added volume settings



A lot of QoL additions such as being able to skip some scenes using ESC

Replaced a lot of sprites and added new ones for extra polish

Improved the UI in the main menu

Performance optimisations

Several bugs fixed
